entry_sequence.transcript_quote: my orb range is still defined by the first 15 minutes of the day
entry_sequence.action: Define the opening range from the first 15 minutes of the session.
entry_sequence.rationale: This keeps the ORB anchored to the opening 15-minute window.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: I have to use the first three candles to define my range high and range low
entry_sequence.action: On the 5-minute chart, use the first three candles to mark the opening range high and low.
entry_sequence.rationale: Those three 5-minute candles represent the first 15 minutes.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: I then wait for my breakout just like before
entry_sequence.action: Wait for an initial breakout above the opening range.
entry_sequence.rationale: The setup starts only after price first breaks out of the range.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: I don't buy immediately on the close of this breakout candle
entry_sequence.action: Do not enter on the initial breakout close.
entry_sequence.rationale: The strategy avoids chasing the first breakout move.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: I have to wait and see if price is going to make a pullback towards the opening range
entry_sequence.action: Wait for price to pull back toward the opening range after the breakout.
entry_sequence.rationale: The pullback is required before looking for continuation.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: what I'm looking for is a candle that's going to break through the range but then close back above it
entry_sequence.action: Wait for a pullback candle that breaks through the range and then closes back above it.
entry_sequence.rationale: This shows price dipping into the range but reclaiming it.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: I'm going to be waiting for a break of this most recent high
entry_sequence.action: After the pullback candle forms, wait for price to break that most recent high as confirmation.
entry_sequence.rationale: The break of the recent high confirms the bounce is continuing.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: this gives me my confirmation to enter into a trade
entry_sequence.action: Enter long when the next candle breaks the high of the pullback confirmation candle.
entry_sequence.rationale: That break is the actual continuation entry trigger.

stop.transcript_quote: the stop loss will still go at the bottom of my opening range
stop.rationale: He says the stop loss still goes at the bottom of the opening range.

targets.transcript_quote: I will target 1 and 1/2 times for my take-profit ratio
targets.rationale: He says to target 1 and 1/2 times for the take-profit ratio.

confluences.transcript_quote: price will often make a pullback and it will return back to the orb
confluences.name: pullback_to_orb
confluences.description: He waits for price to make a pullback and return back to the ORB before entering.

confluences.transcript_quote: what I'm looking for is a candle that's going to break through the range but then close back above it
confluences.name: reclaim_of_opening_range
confluences.description: He wants a candle to break through the range but then close back above it.

confluences.transcript_quote: I want to see buyers coming back in and pushing the price back up
confluences.name: buyers_step_back_in
confluences.description: He wants to see buyers coming back in and pushing the price back up.

confluences.transcript_quote: That gives me confirmation that this line is now starting to act as support
confluences.name: range_line_acts_as_support
confluences.description: He wants confirmation that the range line is starting to act as support.

confluences.transcript_quote: I'm going to be waiting for a break of this most recent high
confluences.name: break_of_recent_high_confirmation
confluences.description: He waits for a break of the most recent high as confirmation.

confluences.transcript_quote: I made sure that this was greater than at least 1 times ATR to be considered a suitable breakout
confluences.name: minimum_breakout_size_atr
confluences.description: He requires the breakout to be greater than at least 1 times ATR to count as suitable.
